---

🛠️ Windows Troubleshooting

• net stop wuauserv → 清除 SoftwareDistribution → net start wuauserv
• net stop cryptsvc → 刪除 catroot2 → net start cryptsvc
• Remove-Item $PROFILE -Force
• winget source reset --force
• devmgmt.msc → 停用 AMD GPU
• sfc /scannow
• DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /RestoreHealth
• where docker

• sudo rm -rf /etc/landscape/client.conf
• sudo systemctl restart landscape-client
